unresolved_source_gaps: The DOCX contains no numbered citations or bibliography. The three included reference PDFs do not cover every manuscript claim.

The manuscript’s descriptions of antisense oligonucleotides, LX1001, APOE3 Christchurch and the meeting with Prof. Keqiang Ye have been imported unchanged. No inferred references were inserted for these paragraphs.

Image placement is based on subject matching because no image anchors were embedded in the DOCX. Source 1.png through 8.png follow the supplied numeric sequence; 图片 1.png matches the explicit REWIRE Figure 4D mention.

Creators and publication licenses for the supplied images were not supplied as a manifest. Paper-source captions were added where supported by the supplied references, but media permissions still require team review.
The supplied risk chart reproduces selected data rows from Yamazaki et al. Table 2. Scientific interpretation and population context were not rewritten.
The supplied papers are retained outside the repository in the extracted source directory; only their bibliographic records and links were integrated.
This is a content migration and link identity check, not scientific or experimental validation.
